subject: general
question: King Lalitaditya Muktapida ruled over ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kashmir.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **King Lalitaditya Muktapida ruled over Kashmir.**
 
• Lalitaditya Muktapida was the grandson of Durlabahaka.
 
• Lalitaditya Muktapida extends the power of Kashmir beyond the normal mountain limits.
 
• Lalitaditya was able to defeat the Turks, Tibetans, Bhutias, and Kambojas.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• The Martand complex of temples perpetuates the memory of King Lalitaditya.

 
• The Karkota dynasty was associated with the history of Jammu and Kashmir.__
 
• Karkota Dynasty was founded by Durlabhvardhana.
 
• Durlabahaka was the son of Durlabhvardhana.
